description: Twitter API: User Profile: one public X (Twitter) account by handle or x.com URL: display name, bio, followers, following, post count, verification, avatar link and creation time, in the shared social schema. Bad input is free; not found or no match is not charged. Price: $0.02 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

handle.description: An X handle (with or without @) or an x.com profile URL.
